- I do not reliably know either of those 2025 figures, so I could not do that subtraction.
- For reference, full-year operating cash flow was about +$45.0 billion in 2023 and about −$8.8 billion in 2024. Bank operating cash flows swing a lot with changes in trading assets and liabilities, so the true Q4 2025 value could be far from my estimate and could even be negative.
